premise: After polynomial normalization to a delta*-critical state G of rank k, both cofactors G[x=0], G[x=1] have maximum deficiency at most k-1.

required_operator.work: polynomial in original input size with exponent independent of k
required_operator.state: polynomial live state and merge metadata
required_operator.replay: polynomial lifting of SAT witness or UNSAT certificate
required_operator.closure: next macrostep remains within the same polynomial accounting envelope

if_proved: Maximum deficiency falls by at least one per exact merged macrostep; at most N steps yield a deterministic polynomial SAT decider, hence P=NP.
known_failed_natural_merges: ordinary CNF Davis-Putnam merge with maxdef rebound
auxiliary-free CNF projection with parity size blowup
